Name: Claude Usage
Author: Aaron Holt
Description: Live Claude usage for one or two Claude Code accounts (session, weekly all-models, weekly scoped-model, extra credits — pick the account per key) plus Codex CLI usage, a Peak Hours key, and CPU load, CPU temperature and memory keys.

Actions.Name: Current Session
Actions.Tooltip: Percent of your current 5-hour Claude session consumed (matches claude.ai Settings).

Actions.Name: Weekly (All Models)
Actions.Tooltip: Percent of your weekly all-models limit consumed.

Actions.Name: Weekly (Scoped Model)
Actions.Tooltip: Percent of your weekly limit for the model Anthropic scopes your account to (auto-labelled — Fable, Sonnet, etc).

Actions.Name: Extra Usage Credits
Actions.Tooltip: Percent of your monthly extra-usage credits consumed.

Actions.Name: Peak Hours
Actions.Tooltip: Whether Claude peak hours (Mon–Fri 5–11 AM Pacific) are on now, with a countdown to the next change. Tap to open claude-peak-time.pages.dev.

Actions.Name: Codex Usage
Actions.Tooltip: OpenAI Codex CLI usage (weekly or 5-hour limit), read from Codex's local logs. Tap to open Codex usage settings.

Actions.Name: CPU Load
Actions.Tooltip: Total CPU load across all cores, refreshed every 2 seconds, with a one-minute graph. Underneath: the 1-minute load average out of your core count. Tap to open Activity Monitor.

Actions.Name: CPU Temperature
Actions.Tooltip: CPU temperature from the Mac’s sensors (average or hottest core, °C or °F), refreshed every 2 seconds. Tap to open Activity Monitor.

Actions.Name: Memory
Actions.Tooltip: Memory available (GB free, the way Activity Monitor counts it), refreshed every 2 seconds, with a 5-minute graph. Green / yellow / red against your low-memory line (default 7 GB), plus a banner when it drops below. Tap to open Activity Monitor.
